dhp273:4:
dvipadānañca → dipadānañca (sya-all) | cakkhumā → mahana aṭhagio śeṭho savana cauri pada 
viraku śeṭho dhamana praṇābhutana cakhuma (bj: prā.dha. A 3 4)
dhp274:1: eseva → esova (bj) | Eseva → esova (cck: sī. pī.)
dhp275:3: vo → ve (pts) | vo → akkhāto ve (cck: sī. pī.)
dhp275:4: sallakantanaṁ → sallasatthanaṁ (bj); sallasanthanaṁ (pts) | sallakantanaṁ → sallasanthanaṁ (cck: sī. pī.); sallasatthanaṁ (cck: syā.)
dhp277:4:
visuddhiyā → savi sasara anica ti yada prañaya paśati 
tada nivitti dukha eso magu visodhi a (bj note)
dhp278:4:
visuddhiyā → savi sasara dukha ti yada prañapha śradhati 
tada nivinati dukha eṣo mago visodhia (bj: prā. dha. A 3 1. 2.)
dhp279:4:
visuddhiyā → sarva dhama anatma ti yada paśati vachuma 
tada tivinati dukha eṣo mago visodhi a (bj: prā. dha. A 3. 3)
dhp280:4:
vindati → utthāna kāleṣū nibhitavīryyāyuvā balī....... ko nirāśaඃ 
sadeva saṁkalpahataඃ kusīdo jñānasya mārgaṁ sattaṁ na vetati (bj: udānavarga apramāda 5 21.); uṭhate alasa anuṭhahatu yoi bali alasae ucito 
saṁsana sagapa mano samatima prañai maga alasu na vinati (bj: prā. dha. A 3 9)
dhp281:2: nākusalaṁ → akusalaṁ na (bj, sya-all, pts) | kayirā → akusalaṁ na kayirā (cck: sī. syā. kaṁ. pī.)
dhp286:4:
bujjhati → iha varṣaṁ kariṣyāmi hemanghaṁ grīṣmameva ca 
bālo vicintayatīti hyantarāyaṁ na paśyāti (bj: anityavagi 5. 38)
dhp287:4:
gacchati → taṁ putrapaśusampannaṁ vyāsakamanasaṁ naram 
supataṁ vyāghro māgamiva mṛtyurādāya gacchati (bj: mahābhārata. 12. 175); taṁ putrapaśūsammattaṁ vyāsaktamānasaṁ taram 
supataṁgrāmaṁ mahogha iva mṛtyurādāya gacchati (bj: udānavarga 1. 5. 39)
